top_signals.title: Gold Falls to July Low as Inflation Concerns Weigh Before Fed
top_signals.summary: Gold fell to the lowest since July as renewed strength in energy prices and weakening US consumer sentiment reinforced inflation concerns just days before the Federal Reserve’s next policy meeting.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
